notes: Reviewed the bundle at 1440, 1024 and 390 (touch), with reduced motion, with the live feed, with the feed blocked, with a corrupt payload (Fed 400.00% - 400.00%, HTML in changed_on, HTML in the EURIBOR display, stale BoE) and with a stale flag only, plus a Div-row copy of the bundle to mirror Webflow output. Screenshots: shots/qa-home/ (concept-* are the approved F file rendered at the same positions for side-by-side). Script: work/qa-home/qa.js; raw results: shots/qa-home/qa-report.json. Fidelity: the prototype matches concept F to the pixel in geometry and type; visible differences are the intended fixes (feed-derived chips and dates, As-of lines, Checked line, solid #4F7879 inactive amounts, 'View 22 selected transactions'). Full-page screenshots show the reveal sections blank; that is a Playwright fullPage artefact with CSS scroll-driven animations (viewport screenshots of the same sections render correctly, see proto-who-we-are-1440.png and proto-what-we-do-1440.png). The wave canvas runs 60 rAF callbacks per second (30 draws) for 8 s after the panel enters the viewport on fine pointers and while the pointer moves, then stops; 0 off-screen, 0 on coarse pointers, 0 under reduced motion. The 'Checked' line is hidden until the feed validates, so there is no layout shift from it in the viewport. shared/site.js still carries the concept-era GSAP and Lenis glue behind feature checks; nothing loads those libraries and the Webflow paste files do not include site.js. Existing live copy 'our team provides advice shaped by current conditions' (Who We Are) is outside the two modules and is general advisory wording, noted for the copy audit rather than this build. Handoff checks passed: addressed to Shikhar, baserate-*/changerate-* ids kept, Transactions collection with fields, Div rows with role and tabindex plus Enter and Space handling, 50,000-character limits stated, staging-first, 10-point QA list, no em dashes, footer carries the live two-paragraph disclaimer verbatim.
